code='''def transform(grid):
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==7]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    out=[[7 if grid[r0+r][c0+c]==7 else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    markers={}
    for color in range(10):
        if color in (0,7): continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
        if pts and len(pts)<=4:
            a=min(r for r,c in pts); b=min(c for r,c in pts)
            markers[tuple(sorted((r-a,c-b) for r,c in pts))]=color
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if out[r][c]!=0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while stack:
                a,b=stack.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and out[x][y]==0 and (x,y) not in seen:
                        seen.add((x,y)); stack.append((x,y))
            a0=min(a for a,b in comp); b0=min(b for a,b in comp)
            key=tuple(sorted((a-a0,b-b0) for a,b in comp))
            color=markers.get(key,0)
            for a,b in comp: out[a][b]=color
    return out
'''
